answer_1.quote: EQA-RM is designed as a generative reward model (GenRM). EQA-RM thus is able to produce not only scalar rewards but also explicit reasoning for its assessments.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of all reward models using the following metrics. • Accuracy measures the proportion of predictions where the gap between the predicted score s p and the target score s gt is within a predefined tolerance τ . We use the tolerance τ = 2 in the experiments: • Root Mean Square Error quantifies the average magnitude of the error between predicted and target scores:

answer_3.quote: VLM-as-a-Judge: State-of-the-art VLMs prompted offline to evaluate EQA responses on our test set. Including Gemini-2.5-Flash , GPT-4o  and Claude-3.5-Haiku.

answer_4.quote: After human verification for reliability, these scores become our ground truth scores (s gt ).
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation criteria include Answer Plausibility & Visual Grounding (60% weight) and Reasoning Trace Quality (40% weight), with sub-criteria such as plausibility, visual confirmation, logic, consistency, and trace-answer consistency.
